note: Roadmap built from the official trophy descriptions and PowerPyx's roadmap (18-19 Nov 2026). No mission replay exists, so the one thing to do on time is the Chapter 1 meditation.

stages.text: Play the story, Chapters 1 to 5, and enjoy it. All 12 chapter and mission trophies pop on their own, and the five side-character questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are marked automatically as the story advances. Do the optional missions as they appear, scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app, and study animals through the binoculars: that progress counts toward the 100% checklist later. The one thing you must not skip: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, accept Lucia's morning meditation on the balcony at Jason's house. It is the only trophy any published guide flags as possibly missable.
stages.title: Stage 1 - Finish the story

stages.text: After the story you return to free-roam and the 100% checklist unlocks under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. It is 35 requirements and closer to 60% true completion: most collectible types are only partly required, and you need 70 of 80 challenges. Nothing on it is missable. This stage is where the silver trophies land: 250 stunts, gold at all 42 shooting range challenges, drone race wins at all 14 Top Fun locations, 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 100 vehicles discovered, 5 bank vaults, one illegal operation per gang, and the money trophies. Keep the checklist open and work through it region by region.
stages.title: Stage 2 - 100% completion checklist

stages.text: Mop up what the checklist did not cover. Strangers & Freaks strands are not needed for 100%, so finish any 8 counted strands here. Then chase the cryptic trophies whose methods are still UNCONFIRMED at launch: a cocktail on Ocean Beach, smashing out of a vehicle showroom, and the three believed-but-unconfirmed ones. Check the Sources page for the latest confirmed methods before farming any of these.
stages.title: Stage 3 - Strangers & Freaks and the cryptic ones

stages.text: When the other 54 trophies are earned, the platinum, Vice Got a Price!, pops by itself. Export your progress from this guide as a keepsake: it holds every trophy, its guide, and the sources you used.
stages.title: Stage 4 - Platinum
